_comment: THE CALLER'S AWARDS (AwardManager): at the end, three awards are drawn at random from those somebody qualifies for (a stat above 'min'); each gives one Dead Rat to whoever has the most (or least, 'low': true) of the stat. 'rats' 2 for the rare ones. Ties: everyone tied gets it. 'ghosts': false if ghosts can't win it.

menace.name: MENACE
menace.desc: Used the most items on other people.

explorer.name: EXPLORER
explorer.desc: Found the most things away from the table.

punching_bag.name: PUNCHING BAG
punching_bag.desc: Got hit by other people the most.

unlucky_bastard.name: UNLUCKY BASTARD
unlucky_bastard.desc: Landed on the most bad squares.

favourite.name: FAVOURITE
favourite.desc: The best luck with his events.

escape_artist.name: ESCAPE ARTIST
escape_artist.desc: Most trips away from the table.

chair_enthusiast.name: CHAIR ENTHUSIAST
chair_enthusiast.desc: Got a seat the most times in THE LAST SEAT.

osha_violation.name: OSHA VIOLATION
osha_violation.desc: Hurt the most by machinery and traps.

tax_evader.name: TAX EVADER
tax_evader.desc: Cheated the most and got away with it.

main_character.name: MAIN CHARACTER
main_character.desc: Spent the most rounds in the lead.

unkillable.name: UNKILLABLE
unkillable.desc: Survived the most things that should have killed them.

wrong_place.name: WRONG PLACE, WRONG TIME
wrong_place.desc: Hit by the most random events.
